\paragraph{Fresh-issue single-look replication of the learned gate (not run).}
We designed a single-look prospective replication of the frozen graded-gate score on independent post-cutoff \texttt{huggingface/datasets} issues and checked its feasibility without a provider call. The snapshot holds 277 issues, 197 with at least one comment (18 with a Markdown link, 46 with a bare URL in the first three comments). Excluding every record number that any retained study mentions leaves 111 issues; the most generous reading, which removes only numbers that could name a record of this repository, leaves 193. After 80 issues for re-deriving the candidate, 31 and 113 calibration groups remain, against the about 150 the design needs: at the registered level no errors could be tolerated among roughly 111 accepted groups, so admission would be unlikely even if the sequential extension's 1.5\% error rate held. We therefore did not run it, and the sequential extension remains the only evidence on this workload: exploratory, adaptive, and not a certificate.
